So: If something is green then it is young. If something is blue then it is young.)
3. All smart, round things are quiet. (If something is smart AND round then it is quiet.)

5. Cold things are young.
6. If something is quiet then it is blue.

Now we have Fiona is blue. Use rule 2: If something is blue then it is young. So Fiona is young.

Thus we derived Fiona is young. So the statement "Fiona is not young" is false (cannot be derived; we derived opposite). The question: Determine whether the statement follows.
